leaves.name: gonzalezRotgerThm512X6RCF
leaves.doc: gr512-bridge, printed form: Gonzalez-Rotger, J. Math. Soc. Japan 58 (2006), Thm 5.12, p. 946 (arXiv math/0612732 pp. 18-19; read by the locator audit), at (D,N) = (6,1), over CM points as Gonzalez-Rotger define them (GRDict.IsGRCMPoint), on every witness of the moduli description: for an order O of k (Tau Ceti NumberFieldOrder) of conductor prime to 6, Q(x) is Q-isomorphic to the ring class field H_R (Tau Ceti ringClassField O) if D(R) != 1, and to a subfield of H_R of index two otherwise; D(R) = product of the p | 6 with pR prime in R (Eichler symbol (R/p) = -1, GR512Bridge.grD6), N*(R) = 1 at N = 1. The old degree form is GR512Bridge.gonzalezRotgerThm512X6_of_rcf (ClassGroup = CommRing.Pic bridge, finrank_ringClassField, grD6_ne_one_iff); LeafQM.O maximal is GR512Bridge.N1.O_maximal.
leaves.flag: reading risk: GR's D(R) is read as the product of the p | D with Eichler symbol (R/p) = -1, which for any quadratic order is 'pR is a prime ideal of R' (GR section 5 definition not re-read on this host; the match with inertCount6 is a Lean proof); locator read by the audit
